page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. No marginal notes, no footnotes, no catchword.

main_text.p: nihil dicamus, quæri potest, quali corpore futu-ri fint electi? Nam hanc quæstionem movet Apostolus 1.Cor.15.35. Ubi etiam electorum corpora, qualia in resurrectione futura sint, describet. Primùm spiritualia erunt, hoc est, substantiâ quidem priora corpora erunt; verùm spiritualia dicuntur, quatenus non ut antea, animali facultate, sed Dei Spiritus virtute immediatè vivent. Deinde gloriosa erunt, utpote conformia corpori Christi. Tertiò potentia ac robusta erunt, quia omnes corporis actiones omni infirmitate liberæ edetur. Quartò erunt incorruptibilia, quæ in æternum vigebunt & vivent. Ergo, ut in summâ dicam, erunt, quoad vitam, spirituales; quoad qualitatem, gloriosa & potentia; quoad tempus & durationem, incorruptibilia & immortalia. In his collocat Apostolus imaginem cœlestis illius hominis Christi, quam in alterâ vitâ gestabimus. Vide de his 1.Cor.15.42. & sequentibus. Congregatione sequetur separatio, qua per angelos ab omnibus mundi plagis coacti, à Christo in throno gloriæ sedente, separabuntur, Matth.24.31. In hac autem separatione, electos ad dextram, reprobos ad lævam statuet, Matth.25.33. Paulus autem separationem in hunc modum futuram innuere videtur. Post-eaquam omnes in unum fuerint coacti, tam electi quàm reprobi; electi rapientur in nubes, in occursum Domini; reprobi verò subsistent in terrâ, in qua etiam judicabuntur. Sed nos non inquirimus in ista curiosius. Tertius effectus

page.notes: The word "Quartò" carries an underline in the print, under the Q, which is not transcribed as a mark. Long s is normalised to plain s throughout (e.g. "postolus", "fubstantiâ", "fpiritualia" read as Apostolus, substantiâ, spiritualia). The line break "Post-" / "-eaquam" keeps the printed dash at the start of the next line. The last line, "Tertius effectus", is a full line and the paragraph runs on from the previous page. No catchword is printed at the foot.
